page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre; page number 133 at top right. Main text in the centre: Greek verb paradigms in lines, with headings and sub-headings. Marginal notes in the right margin beside the paradigm lines (Facerem uel fierem; Infinitus; Futurus; Si faciam uel si fierem). Faint show-through from the other side of the leaf is ignored.
page.notes: Greek accents and breathings are reproduced as best read from the scan; several forms are uncertain. Marginal notes are placed at the foot as they stand beside the paradigm lines. The Greek in the sub-paradigms is printed with the verb forms as shown and may contain printer's errors.
